verdicts.reason: A: the headline runs right into the stacked decorative circles in the top-right corner. The body copy wraps into a cramped three-line block jammed against the CTA, and the bottle nearly touches the top and bottom edges, so the whole banner feels overstuffed. B: it reads more cleanly left to right with the circles moved to the left edge, but the SOLSTICE logo sits high and doesn't line up with the bottle. The one-line subcopy is small and runs close to the right edge, and the CTA is centred under the text column, leaving a dead gap below the logo.
